title: Live whole-window SWAP5-MODFLOW6 service materialization
goal: Materialize one executable service composition that carries an F-GC39 converged window into the F-GC41 publication boundary without changing predictor/corrector ownership or groundwater physics.
invariants: F-GC39 remains owner of coupled nonlinear iteration below iMOD Coupler
F-GC41 remains owner of whole-window preflight/publication ordering
retained SWAP candidate identity must be the same candidate preflighted and published
MODFLOW prepared solve must be finalized before F-GC41 timestep readiness can pass
ledger token must bind the same coupling/window identity
no ordinary rejection after first irreversible publication
no N:1 scaling, Ribasim, irrigation, or new groundwater physics
reconcile_verdict: New composition surface: canonical has qualified F-GC39 and F-GC41 separately but no live end-to-end service composition authority.
next_permitted_action: Open a separately bounded production SWAP participant binding workunit. Bind the real transactional SWAP origin/corrector/candidate publication seams into the admitted F-GC39/F-GC41 composition, then qualify one real end-to-end SWAP+MODFLOW application case. Preserve F-GC39 predictor/corrector ownership and F-GC41 publication ordering.
evidence_boundary: F-GC42 qualifies composition of admitted F-GC39 and F-GC41 contracts. It does not claim a real-SWAP plus real-MODFLOW production application run.
